kv_context.vllm_rule: startup needs cdiv(max_model_len, 64) blocks; the scheduler caps lookahead slots at max_model_len; one block is the null block
kv_context.pool_544_blocks: 34,816 tokens; context at most 34,752 (543 usable blocks), so the K-stop screen pool cannot serve 44,288
kv_context.pool_693_blocks: 44,352 tokens; context at most 44,288 for K2; K-stop uses 44,224 (one request + K3 lookahead + null block = 693 blocks)
kv_context.campaign_sim_rule: the campaign's pre-boot check also counts the K lookahead and the null block (cdiv(L+K, 64) + 1 blocks): 44,288 needs 694 of 693 blocks for K2 and K3 alike; 44,224 (one block less) satisfies both rules
